name: Pinnacle Point Restaurant
address: Pinnacle Point, Mossel Bay, 6506, South Africa
description_short: Clifftop dining with sweeping ocean views and a menu celebrating local seafood and South African favourites.
description_long:
Perched on the dramatic cliffs of Pinnacle Point Estate, this restaurant offers one of Mossel Bay's most spectacular dining settings. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame uninterrupted views of the Indian Ocean, while the spacious deck makes the most of sunny Garden Route days. The menu leans into fresh local seafood—think line fish, calamari, and prawns—alongside well-executed steaks, pastas, and traditional South African dishes.

The atmosphere strikes a balance between relaxed and upmarket, making it suitable for everything from a lazy Sunday lunch to a special occasion dinner. Service is attentive without being stuffy, and the wine list features a solid selection of Western Cape estates. While it's part of the golfing estate, you don't need to be a golfer to appreciate the setting—just book ahead for sunset slots when the light turns the ocean golden.
